name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Timeless Hits Pack
summary:
This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode and Great Drum Toy War.

Timeless Hits Pack contains 5 songs: "TSUGARU KAIKYOU FUYUGESHIKI", "365 Steps March", "Tokyo Ondo", "Furusato (Hometown)" and "Fuji no Yama (Mt. Fuji)".

The songs included in this product may also be available in the Taiko Music Pass.
